newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador Q2 GDP up 0.9 pct - Central Bank source.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador Q2 GDP up 0.9 pct - Central Bank source.

text.p: Ecuador's gross domestic product grew 0.9 percent in the second quarter, down from 4.7 percent growth in the same period of 1995, a top Central Bank source said Friday.
The source, who requested anonymity, told Reuters that uncertainty generated by last July's presidential election caused the economy's expansion to slow down.
"The economy stopped until the election results were known", he said.
Abdala Bucaram was elected president in runoff polls in July.
GDP growth in the first quarter of 1996 was 1.9 percent.
The government predicts the economy will grow 2.9 percent this year and 4.0 percent in 1997, up from 2.3 percent last year but down from 4.3 percent in 1994.
Growth between April and June was led by the trade sector, wich rose 5.4 percent, and agriculture, up 2.5 percent.

The financial services sector contracted 5.7 percent in the same period, while petroleum was off 4.4 percent, followed by a 2.2 percent fall in electricity and 0.5 percent drop in construction, the source said.
